description: Shared Renovate config for the Paper Balloon game and site repos. Repos use it with: "extends": ["github>tim4724/renovate-config"]

packageRules.description: Our own images are deployed by tag or rollout restart. A pinned digest would freeze :latest.
One weekly PR for everything below a major. Renovate merges it only when every check on the branch passed, and never when there are no checks.
Android on its own, so a broken Android build doesn't hold back the web and server updates.
Actions run beside deploy credentials on the self-hosted runners: grouped, merged by hand.
Manifests are applied by hand with kubectl, so a merge alone changes nothing in the cluster.
The Playwright test container has to match @playwright/test exactly.
A Node.js major moves the Dockerfiles, .nvmrc and setup-node together.
CI's kubectl stays on the cluster's minor; bump that by hand with each cluster upgrade.
Odd nginx minors are mainline; stay on the stable (even) line.
